_comment: THE state registry (single source, tracked, worktree-safe). Every hook / skill / script that touches a per-state thing — Task folder, etanah-knowledge dir, repo root, trunk branch, DB MCP, permohonan prefix, BPMN key prefix, Redmine project — resolves it through lib/states.js, never a literal. Add a state = one record here + `node lib/states.js validate <key>`; remove = `node lib/states.js remove <key>`. Hosts / IPs / URLs live in system/states.local.json (gitignored overlay, same shape, deep-merged) — never here. Facts marked `_unverified` are structure copied from the reference state and must be confirmed against a real source before a tool relies on them.

work_scope_values.excluded: HARD EXCLUDED from our work — tools must refuse, never route (no state carries it today; Terengganu went active 2026-10-03)
